structured_output.what_is_happening: A 14-minute-old Meteora pair (not pump.fun) called "bio/acc" rose about 9x to roughly $100k market cap on $1.8M of volume. GeckoTerminal shows 2,082 unique buyers against only 75 unique sellers, and unique buyers fell from 1,629 in m15 to 48 in the latest m5, with price flat (+2%) over that m5. GMGN flags 69 bundler wallets holding 66% of top-trader share and a 53% bot/degen rate. 100% of the LP is unlocked and the creator has already closed their position. At least 9 other bio/acc copies were launched in the past ~6 hours, which points to some trigger (probably a post on X, since GeckoTerminal links to a tweet from tsxxxxxx0 that I couldn't access). I could not identify the event itself.

narrative.description: bio/acc (biotech accelerationism) is an e/acc offshoot meme with real cultural roots: a podcast, bioacc.bio, and BIO Protocol's Bio/Acc rewards. There are older tokens under the same ticker. Many clones appeared today, so something likely triggered it, but I couldn't confirm what.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely a post on X (GeckoTerminal links a tweet from tsxxxxxx0/status/2103766233954865155). It returned HTTP 402, so I couldn't verify it. The burst of same-name deploys fits a reaction to a single event.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is by far the leading bio/acc clone by volume ($1.8M against under $80k for the others) and liquidity, so it is the de facto winner of today's clone race so far.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Older ones: 7dxQE4...pump (Bio Acceleration, 2024) and CLP3ex...pump. Today's clones: F2Fnn, 2VbTP (created about 3 minutes before this one), 5fpFW, CXGjh, DrTa1, FCDq, and others.

authenticity.evidence: 69 bundler wallets hold a top-bundler trader share of 0.66, and the bot/degen rate is 0.53. The buyer/seller asymmetry is extreme (2,082 buyers against 75 sellers) and holder count jumped in about 10 minutes. The creator has closed their position and the LP is 100% unlocked on a non-launchpad Meteora pool. Turnover is 29x market cap in one hour.
authenticity.uncertainty: I couldn't see the X post or any real community discussion, and part of the buyer flow could be real retail from a viral post.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked on a Meteora pool, and there are few LP providers, so the deployer can pull it at any time
Heavy bundler presence (69 wallets, 66% of top-trader share)
Momentum is fading: m5 unique buyers dropped to 48 from 1,629 in m15
It has already run about 9x from launch

structured_output.counterargument: If a large account posted about bio/acc, this leading clone could keep soaking up flow. $65k of liquidity and 2,000+ holders is a lot for a 14-minute-old coin, and a move from $100k to $200k market cap is modest compared with memes that have gone viral.
unknowns: What the tweet linked by GeckoTerminal says and who posted it
Whether the LP deployer is the creator
Whether the 2,000 buyers are real or bots

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract address returned nothing relevant. The X status link returned HTTP 402. General searches only found older bio/acc tokens and the bio/acc movement pages. I didn't search Reddit, Telegram or Discord because of the 2-minute time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled clone on a Meteora pool with 100% of its LP unlocked. It is still the volume leader of a same-day bio/acc clone wave, but it has already run 9x, unique-buyer flow is collapsing, and the creator has exited. Rug risk is high and the chance of another 2x is below average.
